title: MasterLeaderboard
description: MasterLeaderboard tracks the kills of MythicMobs mobs for each player, creates customizable leaderboards, and assigns automatic rewards through console commands.
body:
🌟 MasterLeaderboard
### Advanced MythicMobs Kill Tracking • Leaderboards • Milestones • Rewards

MasterLeaderboard is an advanced leaderboard system for MythicMobs, designed for RPG servers, dungeons, events, and competitive modes.

---

## ✨ Main Features
- Full integration with MythicMobs
- Global, group-based, and per-mob leaderboards
- Milestones with automatic rewards
- Detailed player statistics
- PlaceholderAPI support
- MySQL and SQLite
- Simple and modular configuration
- Lightweight and optimized system

---

## 📊 Leaderboards

Create custom leaderboards for:
- Individual mobs
- Groups
- Total kills
- Daily kills

---

## 🎯 Milestones & Rewards

Create objectives such as:
- “Kill 50 ZombieBoss”
- “Reach 100 kills in the Undead group”
- “Surpass 500 total kills”

Each milestone can execute commands, grant rewards, display titles, or send messages.

---

## 🧪 Player Statistics

Displays:
- Total kills
- Daily kills
- Kills per mob
- Kills per group
- Last kill
- Milestone progress

---

## 📘 Main Commands
/mlb top <id>
/mlb top mob <MobName>
/mlb top group <Group>
/mlb kills <player>
/mlb stats <player>
/mlb reload
/mlb reset

---

## 🔐 Permissions
- masterleaderboard.top
- masterleaderboard.kills
- masterleaderboard.stats
- masterleaderboard.reload
- masterleaderboard.reset
- masterleaderboard.admin

---

## 📚 Full Documentation

The complete documentation is available in the official Wiki.
